preconditions.description: The number of railway stations n must be between 2 and 5000 inclusive.
The number of passengers m must be between 1 and 5000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_i <= n and 1 <= y_i <= n and x_i != y_i for x_i, y_i in sections)
preconditions.description: Each railway section must connect two distinct stations within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_j <= n and 1 <= b_j <= n and a_j != b_j and 1 <= g_j <= 10**6 for a_j, b_j, g_j in queries)
preconditions.description: Each passenger's departure and arrival stations must be valid and distinct, and the minimum scenery beauty must be within the specified range.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not valid else all(1 <= f_i <= 10**6 for f_i in f)
postconditions.description: If no valid assignment exists, output -1; otherwise, all scenery beauty values must be within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: all(min(f[i] for i in path) >= g_j for a_j, b_j, g_j in queries for path in paths(a_j, b_j))
postconditions.description: For each passenger's query, the minimum scenery beauty along the path must be at least the reported value.
